title: MyCloud Mobile
summary: MyCloud Mobile brings business calls, texts and IM’s to your mobile device.
description:
MyCloud Mobile is a SIP soft client that extends VolP functionality beyond the landline or desktop. It brings features of the MyCloud UCaaS platform, such as calling, texting and instant messaging directly to end user's mobile devices as a Unified Communications solution. With MyCloud Mobile, users can maintain the same identity when making or receiving calls and texts from any location, regardless of their device. Users also can seamlessly send an ongoing call from one device to another and continue that call without interruption. MyCloud Mobile grants users the ability to manage contacts, voicemail, call history and configurations in a single location. This includes managing answering rules, greetings, and presence for more efficient communication.

****NOTICE: You must have an existing account with a supported service provider for MyCloud Mobile to work.****
